body:
CLOSED. The completion was met on 10-19. The order stayed open only because its 21:09 answer (ack-sciences-g2-co-mainline003-amended-assigned-1019) declared links_none, which turns the close off.

Map point 2 records Una's correction as a qualification, not a source objection, and carries P2-A x2.30, P3-A x4.31 and P1-A x1.38 as QUESTIONABLE directions (MAP2-QUALIFICATION.json; its three pins match today).

MAINLINE-003 ran on the amended scope: 276 MPa entered as a QUESTIONABLE tensile-to-compression transfer, and strength SFs were reported QUESTIONABLE (rpt-mainline003-grok-p2-targets-1019, 21:17). The XO admitted it at 22:16 (rpt-xo-mainline003-review-600-sci-1019), with two text-only NFI defects and no number changed.

The ruling's standard holds as written: QUESTIONABLE is the tag for estimates, never a source gate, and NFI-AL-YIELD-CARRY stays parallel. This filing answers the board stall. Nothing was recomputed for it.
